text_block_list.name: Narrator
text_block_list.text:
That message arrived one morning during our training camp.
I hurried over to Calstone Light O.
choice_data_list: Light O, do you have a moment?

text_block_list.name: Calstone Light O
text_block_list.text:
Trainer?
What's the matter, in such a rush?
choice_data_list: The "Sprinters Stakes" has been moved to Niigata!

text_block_list.name: Calstone Light O
text_block_list.text:
Niigata?
Is it not going to be at Nakayama Racecourse?

text_block_list.name: Narrator
text_block_list.text: Just as she said, the Sprinters Stakes is usually held at Nakayama Racecourse.

text_block_list.name: Narrator
text_block_list.text:
However, flaws were found in the grandstand facilities,
and we were suddenly notified that the venue would be
changed to Niigata Racecourse.

text_block_list.name: Calstone Light O
text_block_list.text:
I just went to Niigata for the Ibis Summer Dash.
It feels like a strange twist of fate.
choice_data_list: Yeah. Having that experience under your belt might give you an edge.
Yeah. Having that experience might give you an advantage.

text_block_list.name: Narrator
text_block_list.text:
"Among the runners in the Sprinters Stakes,
few Umamusume have experience running at Niigata Racecourse.
That difference in experience might play a part."

text_block_list.name: Narrator
text_block_list.text:
Compared to Nakayama Racecourse with its steep hill,
Niigata Racecourse's 1200m course has the distinct difference
of being almost entirely flat.

text_block_list.name: Narrator
text_block_list.text:
Looks like we'll need to rethink our training
heading into the Sprinters Stakes.
choice_data_list: I'll rework the training menu. Let's have a meeting about it later.

text_block_list.name: Calstone Light O
text_block_list.text:
Understood.
I'll be counting on you.

text_block_list.name: Narrator
text_block_list.text: While discussing a new training regimen with Calstone Light O at the camp lodge...

text_block_list.name: Sakura Bakushin O
text_block_list.text: "Calstone-san, Trainer-san, good morning!"

text_block_list.name: Sakura Bakushin O
text_block_list.text: Are those your plans for today?

text_block_list.name: Sakura Bakushin O
text_block_list.text:
In that case, let's cancel the entire schedule!
Allow me to propose a far more splendid
and meaningful regimen!
choice_data_list: You haven't even looked at what's on the menu, have you!?

text_block_list.name: Sakura Bakushin O
text_block_list.text:
I can tell without even looking!
After all, I am the Class President!!

text_block_list.name: Calstone Light O
text_block_list.text: A routine more meaningful than the current one? There's no way it could surpass the Trainer's plan.

text_block_list.name: Sakura Bakushin O
text_block_list.text:
A race!!
Let's settle this with a match, Daitaku Helios-san!

text_block_list.name: Calstone Light O
text_block_list.text:
An instant answer!?
To think Trainer's speed could surpass my own...!
choice_data_list: Because it's Sakura Bakushin O, you know?!
Because it's Sakura Bakushin O, you know?!

text_block_list.name: Narrator
text_block_list.text:
Sakura Bakushin O...
the undisputed, supreme sprinter.

text_block_list.name: Narrator
text_block_list.text:
She suffered only a single defeat in sprint races.
Though she has now stepped away from the front lines, her strength
is still revered as an unfading legend.

text_block_list.name: Narrator
text_block_list.text:
To think I can run with that Sakura Bakushin O.
I am certain to gain a great deal of insight.
choice_data_list: Let's gain some experience racing against the strongest sprinter!

text_block_list.name: Calstone Light O
text_block_list.text:
Grrr, so frustrating! Utterly frustrating!
Are you implying Bakushin O is faster than me!?
I am deeply dissatisfied with this!!

text_block_list.name: Calstone Light O
text_block_list.text:
Like seeing a stray cat you've been secretly feeding
cozying up to someone else!
I'm jealous! Burning with envy!!

text_block_list.name: Sakura Bakushin O
text_block_list.text:
Then let's take all that burning passion
and unleash it on the racetrack!

text_block_list.name: Calstone Light O
text_block_list.text: Yes! I'll show off my speed! And win back Trainer's attention!!
choice_data_list: (This was for Light O in the first place, though...)

text_block_list.name: Narrator
text_block_list.text:
I don't think Calstone Light O will listen properly if I talk to him now.
I'll have a serious talk with him later once he calms down...

text_block_list.name: Narrator
text_block_list.text:
We decided to rent an outdoor racetrack near the training camp.
Anticipating the Sprinters Stakes, I requested a 1,200m setup.

text_block_list.name: Sakura Bakushin O
text_block_list.text:
As far as I'm concerned,
a straight 1000m course would have been just fine too.

text_block_list.name: Sakura Bakushin O
text_block_list.text:
1,200m is my specialty distance!
I'll run it as if it's the real Sprinters Stakes!

text_block_list.name: Calstone Light O
text_block_list.text:
Breaking my top speed.
That is the sole objective I strive for!

text_block_list.name: Narrator
text_block_list.text: (CLUNK!)

text_block_list.name: Sakura Bakushin O
text_block_list.text: Haaaaah!

text_block_list.name: Calstone Light O
text_block_list.text: Wh-what... She passed me?! Kh!
choice_data_list: Light O, don't rush! Your form is falling apart!

text_block_list.name: Calstone Light O
text_block_list.text: Haa, haa...

text_block_list.name: Narrator
text_block_list.text:
The result was a crushing victory for Sakura Bakushin O.
Calstone Light O wasn't allowed
to run her own race at all...

text_block_list.name: Narrator
text_block_list.text: Sakura Bakushin O seized the lead right from the start. She completely controlled the race from beginning to end.

text_block_list.name: Narrator
text_block_list.text: Sakura Bakushin O shows her true clutch strength as expected. Her tactical execution is brilliant, and on top of that, her speed is outstanding.

text_block_list.name: Sakura Bakushin O
text_block_list.text:
"That really is some incredible speed, Daitaku Helios-san!
Just as expected of someone striving for top-end velocity!"

text_block_list.name: Calstone Light O
text_block_list.text:
I return those words right back to you.
You beat me, which means you were the faster one.

text_block_list.name: Sakura Bakushin O
text_block_list.text: Yes, because I am extraordinarily fast!

text_block_list.name: Calstone Light O
text_block_list.text:
That race just now made me realize...
Bakushin O is beyond my top speed.

text_block_list.name: Calstone Light O
text_block_list.text: You're very fast. I respect that.

text_block_list.name: Sakura Bakushin O
text_block_list.text: Fufu, what sweet words! But after watching the Ibis Summer Dash, you're the one I wanted to compete against.

text_block_list.name: Sakura Bakushin O
text_block_list.text: My Bakushin instincts were tingling!

text_block_list.name: Sakura Bakushin O
text_block_list.text: "Calstone-san, won't you master speed together with me?"

text_block_list.name: Sakura Bakushin O
text_block_list.text:
We shall multiply my speed
with your speed!

text_block_list.name: Sakura Bakushin O
text_block_list.text:
Bakushin O times Right O
makes double the king!!
choice_data_list: ...If it's King times King, wouldn't that be King squared?

text_block_list.name: Sakura Bakushin O
text_block_list.text:
It's the same thing!
Right O-san, you will claim another crown—

text_block_list.name: Sakura Bakushin O
text_block_list.text:
I can evolve into
"Calstone Light O-Oh"!

text_block_list.name: Calstone Light O
text_block_list.text: Calstone Light Oooo...!!

text_block_list.name: Calstone Light O
text_block_list.text: That is... that sounds insanely fast!!

text_block_list.name: Calstone Light O
text_block_list.text:
There's an extra long dash in my name now!
That means I'm definitely fast!!

text_block_list.name: Godolphin Barb
text_block_list.text:
Perhaps they felt a sense of sympathy.
As fellow sprinters, that is.

text_block_list.name: Godolphin Barb
text_block_list.text:
Bakushin O-chan is also a girl
with an exceptionally strong desire to run fast.

text_block_list.name: Godolphin Barb
text_block_list.text: If we train together, I'm sure we can inspire each other.

text_block_list.name: Sakura Bakushin O
text_block_list.text:
Oho, I've received the Goddesses' seal of approval!
Naturally, because I'm me!

text_block_list.name: Sakura Bakushin O
text_block_list.text:
Well then, I look forward to working with you!
You can count on me big time!

text_block_list.name: Narrator
text_block_list.text: And so, Calstone Light O managed to secure Sakura Bakushin O's cooperation.
